Company Description

Visa is a world leader in payments and technology, with over 259 billion payments transactions flowing safely between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities in more than 200 countries and territories each year. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive while driven by a common purpose – to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Make an impact with a purpose-driven industry leader. Join us today and experience #LifeatVisa.

Job Description

The Global Data Office

With data being the fuel that drives our future - our strategies, policies, and business successes around data will define our future growth prospects. Unlocking the value available through the innovative use of data on behalf of consumers, businesses, and communities is key to our future. With our ongoing commitment to Visa’s Data Values and the responsible use of data, we at Visa have a bold vision to continue to grow and accelerate our data-related businesses and capabilities.

Led by Visa’s first Chief Data Officer, the Global Data Office coordinates high-impact, complex, company-wide projects related to data business strategy, critical investments, policy development, and marketplace execution. Working closely with Visa’s Chief Privacy Officer, the Technology organization, the wider data community, and the full set of Visa’s global lines of business, the Global Data Office is evolving Visa’s data-related work with momentum and enthusiasm. Driven by its commitment to trusted use of data, Visa is seeking enthusiastic leaders who are change-agents and passionate about the future of data around the world.

The Global AI & Data Innovation team is creating the next generation of scalable and responsible AI, ML and Data Innovations and products to solve client and consumer problems. We are a cross-functional team of data scientists, product managers, AI and data engineers, program managers focused on generating value for the payments ecosystem

We are dreaming of the next generation of AI features and products. In this position, you will be a key product leader helping shape our AI product efforts, specifically focused on personalization capabilities and signals. These personalization capabilities and signals will power Data Tokens and many other personalization-related use cases. The ultimate goals is to better link consumers with products and services, with benefits for every party in the payments ecosystem (consumers, businesses).

Responsibilities include:
• Creates strategy and roadmap for Visa’s AI features, products and innovations, focused on personalization capabilities, models and signals
• Drive and deliver product features through their entire creative cycle: ideation, specification, development, internal approvals, release, analysis, and iteration
• Leads other product managers
• Provides structure for projects and deliverables through Visa’s agile methodology. This includes specifying user stories, building epics and prioritizing development efforts
• Collaborate with a wide range of data scientists, data engineers and machine learning engineers to create robust and scalable solutions
• Establishes strong relationships and collaborations across regions and business units, including technical and non-technical cross functional partners
• Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews to report on progress and critical milestones to the leadership
• Be the internal and external champion of AI initiatives and the value of AI overall driving interest and support across all areas
• Be responsible for achieving the key performance indicators you are entrusted with
• Member of the AI & Data Innovation leadership team

This is a hybrid position. Hybrid employees can alternate time between both remote and office. Employees in hybrid roles are expected to work from the office 2-3 set days a week (determined by leadership/site), with a general guidepost of being in the office 50% or more of the time based on business needs.

• 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 10 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters/MBA /JD/MD), or a minimum of 5 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:
• 15 or more years of experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 12 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, or MD), PhD with 9+ years of experience
• 15+ years of product management or related industry experience (12+ years of experience with an advanced degree)

• Experience with designing products working closely with legal and compliance, privacy partners ensuring they meet policies
• Experience working with Tech infrastructure and delivery teams to deliver products on schedule
• Advanced knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science techniques, both exploratory and in production
• Ability to leverage user insights, data, and statistical analyses to inform decisions
• Experience with agile delivery and in managing scrum teams and typical practices (like epic and spring planning using Jira, Jira Align, etc.)
• A desire to build 0-1 products from the ground up
• Demonstrated strong leadership, organizational, and execution skills, along with proven communication abilities
• Experience working in global organizations and roles that need collaboration with stakeholders, partners and development team spread around the globe, gathering regional and global requirements
• Diplomat – excellent stakeholder management skills
• Deep experience building and recruiting world-class teams

Additional Information

Mental/Physical Requirements: This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

The Opportunity

Reporting into the Head of the Technology Office, the Director will help shape and implement our AI Platform, ensuring the solution is scalable, secure, and aligned with our goals.

The Role

Technical Expertise
• Experience with AI/ML: Develop and implement AI/ML models and algorithms using advanced principles, architectures, and frameworks. Utilize proficiency in popular programming languages and libraries to drive AI development projects.
• Experience with AI platforms and products: Design, develop, or manage AI platforms, including cloud-based platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google with large and small language models (open and closed).
• Data engineering skills: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines, implement data processing techniques, and manage data storage solutions for AI workloads.
• Software engineering best practices: Leverage software development lifecycle, DEVOPS, and testing methodologies to ensure scalable AI solutions.

Leadership and Management
• Strategic thinking: Align AI programs with overarching team goals and translate them into actionable roadmaps.
• Team building and mentorship: Build and direct AI teams, promote a culture of innovation and learning.
• Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with stakeholders and leaders across different areas of the business.
• Project management: Manage partners, deliver AI projects on time and within budget, manage resources and risks.

Strategic Vision
• Industry awareness: Stay informed about the latest trends and advancements in AI technology, identify potential opportunities and threats.
• Storytelling: You will explain vision and journey in a compelling manner.
• Innovation focus: Encourage experimentation and exploration of the latest AI techniques to lead competitive advantage.
• Ethical considerations: With your understanding of the ethical possible effects of AI, ensure responsible and fair AI development and deployment.
• Champion AI, its potential, and our roadmap with all partners.
• Continuously research, stay up to date with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning.
• Communicate complex AI concepts to create solutions with non-technical colleagues to lead awareness, adoption, and excitement.

Vendor Management:
• Responsible for contractual ownership for AI technology providers.
• Manage vendor relationships and ensure service levels and contractual obligations are met.

Financial Management:
• Responsible for $10million+ AI & cloud platform budget

Team Leadership:
• Lead a high-performing team of IT professionals.
• Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Your Skills and Experience
• Undergraduate degree in computer science, computer engineering, information technology, mathematics, or equivalent
• Master's degree and related certifications desirable
• 10+ years' relevant IT experience
• 4+ years' managerial experience and/or demonstrated leadership experience.
• Experience managing IT projects within a global environment.
• Pharma/Biotech or similarly regulated environment experience desirable
• Background in solution architecture, with a focus on cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
• Engage with all kinds of stakeholders, technical and non-technical.
• Demonstrated experience implementing integrated roadmaps for cloud platforms.
• Demonstrated experience working with LLM models.
• DevOps experience and ML/AI engineering a plus.

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $190,000 - $260,000. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position at the listed location as of the time of this posting. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity.

Our Benefits

CSL employees that work at least 30 hours per week are eligible for benefits effective day 1. We are committed to the wellbeing of our employees and their loved ones. CSL offers resources and benefits, from health care to financial protection, so you can focus on doing work that matters. Our benefits are designed to support the needs of our employees at every stage of their life. Whether you are considering starting a family, need help paying for emergency back up care or summer camp, looking for mental health resources, planning for your financial future, or supporting your favorite charity with a matching contribution, CSL has many benefits to help achieve your goals.

CSL Behring is a global leader in developing and delivering high-quality medicines that treat people with rare and serious diseases. Our treatments offer promise for people in more than 100 countries living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas.
